verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents SSO with MFA across all SAML and OIDC apps, which covers the 'sign in once' part of the story, and one community user reports its SSO works reasonably well. Nothing in the evidence describes an employee-facing launcher dashboard, an app catalog of assigned apps, or a browser extension. missing for 10: documented user portal/launcher dashboard listing assigned apps, browser extension, evidence of per-user app assignment shown to employees, independent hands-on corroboration of the portal experience.
